en.title: 100 points: AI agents in development
en.description: 100 points for adopting AI agents in development — a practical checklist from the engineers of the NextTick guild.
en.headerH1: Effective adoption of AI agents in development
en.promoText: This checklist is built on personal experience and discussions about advancing AI in the NextTick guild. Want to be at the cutting edge of real, practical agent use? Join us.
en.ds0q: Do 3+ developers on your team actively use agents?
en.ds0note: Count everyone who writes prompts and runs agents in their workflow.
en.ds1q: Do you need prompt and workflow standardization across the whole team?
en.ds1note: Want everyone to use the same agent roles, the same slash commands, the same templates?
en.ds2q: Need TDD-first enforcement — the agent can't skip tests?
en.ds2note: Want a strict workflow: test first, then code, no exceptions?
en.ds3q: Does the project span the full cycle (idea → PM → architecture → code → QA)?
en.ds3note: Need specialized agent personas: PM, Architect, Developer, QA?
en.ds4q: Are you a solo dev who wants to work like a virtual team?
en.ds4note: CEO/Designer/QA modes in one tool — that's gstack.
en.ds6q: Is this an experiment / PoC, or do you want full customization of the flow?
en.noResults: Nothing found. Try a different query.

ru.description: 100 пунктов внедрения ИИ-агентов в разработку — практический чеклист от инженеров гильдии NextTick.
ru.promoText: Этот чеклист разработан на основании личного опыта и дискуссий про развитие AI в гильдии NextTick. Хочешь быть на острие реального практического применения агентов — присоединяйся.
